biochar_feedstock.rice husk + cotton seed shell: Mixture of rice husk and shell of cotton seed

notes: GT column 'CropYield_T ' has a trailing space - must use exact name 'CropYield_T ' (with space) in matching.
GT column 'CropYield_T _SD' also has a trailing space in the column name.
GT column 'CropYield_T _N' also has a trailing space in the column name.
The GT effect column CropYield_RR is a response ratio (treatment/control), while extraction uses effect_pct (percent change). Conversion: RR = 1 + effect_pct/100, or effect_pct = (RR - 1) * 100.
GT also has CropYield_LNRR (log response ratio) which can be used as an alternative effect size check.
Units vary widely in extraction data (g pot-1, kg/ha, t/ha, kg/m2) - unit normalization will be needed before numeric comparison with GT values.
Some extraction observations use pot experiment units (g pot-1) which may not directly correspond to field-scale GT values (t/ha or kg/ha).

Several extraction paper_ids (e.g., 101_Liang_Feng_2014, 116_Farrell_2014, 126_Arif_2017, etc.) could not be confirmed against GT Author column sample values - mapping is based on StudyID numbering inference and may need verification.
The GT dataset has 80 StudyIDs but only ~40 are expected in the validation subsample; not all GT rows will have crop yield data populated.
Some extraction observations include multi-season or cumulative yields (e.g., 't/ha (total over 4 seasons)') which may not match single-season GT values.
The extraction field 'n' corresponds to sample size (replicates), mapping to both CropYield_CK_N and CropYield_T _N in GT.
Extraction uses both 'control_sd' and 'control_SE' fields; GT stores SD - SE values need to be converted (SD = SE * sqrt(n)) before comparison.
The GT CropYield_RR range (0.07 to 9.60) and CropYield_LNRR range (-2.65 to 2.26) suggest some extreme outliers that may cause matching issues.

Study mapping for papers with IDs > 82 (101, 116, 126, 130, 133, 145, 153, 166, 184, 193, 207, 219, 223, 227, 229, 231, 234, 242) are inferred from the numeric portion of the paper_id matching GT StudyID - these should be verified against Author and Year columns.
